A customized [[Color/Legends|blue-and-white]] '''Z-95 Headhunter''' was owned by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Rial Pernon]] of [[Eiattu 6]]. He customized the engines, as well as painted the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] with a blue flame paint scheme. He flew it to assist [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] on their [[Eiattu Campaign|mission]] on the planet after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Warrior" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Z-95 appears in [[Dark Horse Comics]]' ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Warrior Princess]]'' story arc.<ref name="Warrior" />

==Appearances==
*[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 14|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 14]] {{1st}}
